name: Time log
description: Reads one or more values from instruments at a fixed interval (temperatures, voltages, currents...) and records them over time.

duration_s.description: the whole log: no sample is taken after it (without it every source needs 'samples')

item.name: string (the table of its results: not 'points' nor 't_s')
item.interval_s: number >= 0.001, the time between two samples
item.scan: true: a datalogger read as one scan, with 'channels' instead of 'readings'
item.channels: scan only: [{name, channel_id, meas_type, range?, resolution?, probe_type?, sensor_type?}]

sources.description: one entry per instrument, each at its own interval (the current format)

interval_s.description: earlier format: the one interval of all the channels

samples.description: earlier format: stop after this many samples (or use 'duration_s')

channels.description: earlier format: the channels of the single interval
